_comment: Structural analysis constants from PDynA (https://github.com/WMD-group/PDynA). These constants control tolerance thresholds, search radii, and other parameters used throughout the structural analysis modules.

default_tolerance_constants._comment: Default tolerance values used in octahedral matching and structure analysis

fitting_tolerance.description: Used in match_bx_orthogonal() and match_bx_orthogonal_rotated() for matching octahedral bond vectors to ideal coordinates. Controls how strict the matching is.

match_tolerance.description: Tolerance for coordinate matching in pseudo-cubic lattice parameter calculations (in Angstroms).

bb_search_radius.description: Search radius for finding B-B neighbors in polytype network analysis (in Angstroms).

population_gap_tol.description: Tolerance for population gap detection when separating first and second nearest neighbors in distance matrices.

rmsd_threshold.description: RMSD threshold for octahedral matching validation. Used to determine if a match is acceptable.

angle_tolerance.description: Tolerance for angle matching in octahedral analysis.

distinct_threshold.description: Threshold for distinguishing different halide configurations in mixed halide octahedra.

octahedral_matching_thresholds._comment: Thresholds specific to octahedral matching operations

fitting_tol.description: Alternative name for fitting_tolerance, used in some matching functions.

confidence_bound.description: Confidence bounds for matching quality assessment (currently not actively used but available for future validation).

match_tol.description: Matching tolerance for time-averaged structure calculations (in Angstroms).

hydrogen_bond_detection._comment: Parameters for hydrogen bond detection in molecular analysis

max_distance.description: Maximum H...acceptor distance for hydrogen bond detection (in Angstroms).

min_angle.description: Minimum D-H...A angle for hydrogen bond detection (in degrees). Currently defined but not actively used in detection.

tolerance.description: Tolerance below which distortion values are set to zero in simply_calc_distortion().
